title: Thermal drift calibration
text: Temperature drift in a sensor changes its baseline. Compare calibrated and uncalibrated residual mean squared error on matched samples; a lower residual does not alone establish field reliability.

title: Missing sensor observations
text: Sensor dropout creates missing observations. Compare an imputation variant with the baseline on a held-out sequence and report the missingness rate and reconstruction error.

title: Vibration reconstruction
text: A vibration autoencoder reconstructs sampled machine signals. Reconstruction mean squared error can identify changed operating conditions, but threshold calibration and labeled validation are separate experiments.

title: Energy demand residuals
text: Energy demand forecasting residuals measure errors between predicted and observed power. Align timestamps and units before comparing smoothing or feature variants.

title: Cache expiry reliability
text: Simultaneous cache expiration causes a cache stampede. Dynamic TTL and rate limiting reduce request bursts; measure peak throughput on the same workload rather than extrapolating to all requests.

title: Aligned catalog sorting
text: Time, magnitude, position and class labels must share one sorting permutation. Sorting each column independently destroys event alignment and invalidates subsequent analysis.

title: Fourier stress synthesis
text: Conjugate-symmetric Fourier coefficients and an inverse two-dimensional FFT synthesize real stress fields. Compare runtime for the same grid and preserve the intended spatial correlation.

title: Exponential moving averages
text: Irregular events first become fixed-interval counts. Normalized exponential moving-average weights smooth count histories; the observation interval and decay parameter change the interpretation.

title: Retry semantics
text: Retry a failed tool only if its operation is idempotent or deduplicated. A bounded retry count prevents indefinite loops, while a checkpoint records completed tool observations.

title: Evidence attribution
text: An experimental report associates factual claims with retrieved source identifiers and observed run metrics. Source presence validates attribution, not semantic entailment or factual truth.

title: Controlled evaluation
text: Use separate training and evaluation sets. Compare ablations on matched workloads, record random seeds, and distinguish a scripted control-plane test from model reasoning accuracy.

title: Industrial deployment scope
text: An offline synthetic prototype does not control machinery. Field deployment requires domain-specific validation, permissions, monitoring and independently reviewed operational procedures.
